Load hoopR NBA Stats draft combine tables

Source: R/load_nba_stats_extra.R
load_nba_stats_draft_combine.Rd

Five loaders for the five tables of the nba_stats_draft_combine release, one file per table per season: load_nba_stats_draft_combine_stats() (draftcombinestats, the one-row-per-prospect summary of every measurement), load_nba_stats_draft_combine_anthro() (draftcombineplayeranthro, body measurements), load_nba_stats_draft_combine_drills() (draftcombinedrillresults, vertical leaps, agility and sprint), load_nba_stats_draft_combine_spot_shooting() (draftcombinespotshooting, made/attempted from five floor spots at 15 feet, the college three and the NBA three) and load_nba_stats_draft_combine_nonstationary_shooting() (draftcombinenonstationaryshooting, off-the-dribble and on-the-move shooting).

The combine is held in May before the draft, so the season's START year is the combine year: seasons = 2024 reads the 2024 combine (the ..._2025 asset). Columns a year's combine did not measure are all NA.

Usage

load_nba_stats_draft_combine_stats(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_nba_stats_draft_combine_anthro(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_nba_stats_draft_combine_drills(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_nba_stats_draft_combine_spot_shooting(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_nba_stats_draft_combine_nonstationary_shooting(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_stats_draft_combine release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_stats_draft_combine, published by https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit years – the season's START year, i.e. the year of the combine. Published coverage starts at 2000. Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season.

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per prospect (load_nba_stats_draft_combine_stats()).

col_nametypesdescription
seasonintegerEND year of the season the draft class enters (2025 = the May 2024 combine for the 2024 draft) – one more than the seasons argument.
player_idintegerstats.nba.com player identifier (PERSON_ID).
first_namecharacterParticipant's first name.
last_namecharacterParticipant's last name.
player_namecharacterParticipant's full name.
positioncharacterPosition listed by the combine (e.g. 'PG', 'SF-PF').
height_wo_shoesnumericHeight without shoes, in inches.
height_wo_shoes_ft_incharacterHeight without shoes as feet-and-inches text (e.g. "6' 5.75”").
height_w_shoesnumericHeight in shoes, in inches; NA in recent combines, which stopped measuring it.
height_w_shoes_ft_incharacterHeight in shoes as feet-and-inches text; NA when not measured.
weightcharacterWeight in pounds, as text (e.g. '227.80').
wingspannumericWingspan, in inches.
wingspan_ft_incharacterWingspan as feet-and-inches text.
standing_reachnumericStanding reach, in inches.
standing_reach_ft_incharacterStanding reach as feet-and-inches text.
body_fat_pctnumericBody-fat percentage; NA in combines that did not publish it.
hand_lengthnumericHand length, in inches.
hand_widthnumericHand width (span), in inches.
standing_vertical_leapnumericNo-step vertical leap, in inches.
max_vertical_leapnumericRunning (max) vertical leap, in inches.
lane_agility_timenumericLane agility drill time, in seconds.
modified_lane_agility_timenumericModified (shuttle) lane agility drill time, in seconds.
three_quarter_sprintnumericThree-quarter-court sprint time, in seconds.
bench_pressintegerRepetitions of the 185 lb bench press; NA where not tested.
spot_fifteen_corner_leftcharacterSpot-up shooting from the left corner at 15-foot range, as 'made-attempted' text.
spot_fifteen_break_leftcharacterSpot-up shooting from the left break (wing) at 15-foot range, as 'made-attempted' text.
spot_fifteen_top_keycharacterSpot-up shooting from the top of the key at 15-foot range, as 'made-attempted' text.
spot_fifteen_break_rightcharacterSpot-up shooting from the right break (wing) at 15-foot range, as 'made-attempted' text.
spot_fifteen_corner_rightcharacterSpot-up shooting from the right corner at 15-foot range, as 'made-attempted' text.

See also

The publishing pipeline, https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data, the draft results in load_nba_stats_draft(), and the Python twins sportsdataverse.nba.load_nba_stats_draft_combine_*().
